source: Per our SLA, remediation of the P2 incident will be effectuated within 4 business hours.
target: We'll have this fixed within 4 business hours. Thanks for your patience!

source: Your request has been escalated to Tier 3 for further investigation.
target: I've passed this to our senior engineers, and they'll dig in right away.

source: Kindly be advised that the invoice discrepancy has been rectified.
target: Good news: we've fixed the invoice mistake.

source: The feature you requested is not on the current roadmap.
target: That feature isn't planned yet, but I've shared your idea with the product team.

source: Authentication failure due to expired credentials. Re-authenticate.
target: Your password has expired. Reset it here and you'll be back in.

source: We are unable to process refunds outside the 30-day window.
target: Refunds are available for 30 days after purchase, so this one falls outside the window. Here's what I can offer instead.

source: Service degradation was observed in the West Europe region.
target: Some customers in Europe saw slowdowns. It's resolved now, and we're sorry for the trouble.

source: Please provide the requisite documentation to proceed.
target: Could you send us a copy of the receipt? Then we can move ahead.

source: Your ticket has been closed due to inactivity.
target: We closed this ticket since we hadn't heard back. Just reply if you still need help!

source: A configuration change will be deployed during the maintenance window.
target: We're making an update on Sunday night, and you shouldn't notice any downtime.

source: Data export functionality is restricted to administrator roles.
target: Only admins can export data. Ask your admin, or I can tell you who that is.

source: Your subscription will auto-renew on the stipulated date.
target: Your plan renews automatically on 1 November. No action needed.
